==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro|*pan-}}. The SED regards Arabic {{m|ar|فِنَاء}} ("yard") and Sabaic and Minaean ''fnw(t)'' ("space outside a building") as probably derived from this root, as well as the Modern South Arabian adverbs such as Mehri {{m|gdq|fōnəh}} ("earlier"). Hebrew {{m|hbo|פָּנִים|tr=pānīm}} is a plural-only noun.
